Where it fits

An experience shaped around your gathering.

One physical product can give guests an easy way into different conversations. We can choose the format that fits your audience and program.

01 / OPEN FLOOR

Walk-up discovery

A staffed, hands-on station for meetups and receptions. Guests see the desk move, try controls, and ask questions at their own pace.

02 / BUILDER CROWD

Hardware conversation

A live demonstration that opens discussion around mechanics, sensing, software, interaction, and the path from prototype to product.

03 / WORKSPACE

Five-minute fit session

A short guided experience for coworking guests to explore sitting, standing, and tilted work positions.

Suitable for a scheduled demo window or a longer staffed activation, depending on venue and program.

Hosting details

Simple to bring in. Memorable to experience.

Vico can bring the desk, set it up, demonstrate it, and remove it afterward. Share your venue layout and timing, and we’ll find the right placement and demo window together.
